messages:
maya: we just got a delivery from partner: weights + tokenizer + manifest for vectra-27b-v0. putting it on s3 under a tmp prefix for intake: s3://redwood-ingest/tmp/vectra-27b/ :pray:

oleg: thanks. do we have a detached signature or cosign? can you paste the manifest contents?

maya: manifest attached in the bundle: manifest.sha256 (list of files + sha256), and manifest.sig (PGP detached). also a `release.json` with model_id and training-commit. they dropped tokenizer files as tokenizer.json + merges.txt + vocab.bin (spacy-style).

sophia: quick checklist I run for intake: 1) verify sha256 of every file vs manifest  2) verify PGP signature against partner signing key 3) run artifact-validator smoke (load weights *on single-gpu*) 4) tokenizer sanity (decode roundtrip on sample) 5) register to registry with provenance metadata. anyone object?

devin: sounds good. for step 2 we should also cosign the tarball if partner provided a cosign blob (they often do now). command I use locally: ```cosign verify-blob --key <key> --signature manifest.sig bundle.tar.gz``` but if it's PGP we do: ```gpg --verify manifest.sig manifest.tar.gz```

maya: partner included both pgp and a cosign signature blob. signature key id is 0xA1B2C3D4 (contacted partner to confirm). I'll run verify and post output.

artifact-validator-bot: CHECKSUMS OK: weights.000 sharded files (10) all match manifest.sha256

oleg: great. next: tokenizer mapping. we saw a few unknown bytes when loading with our HF tokenizer loader. sophia, can you run a quick roundtrip test? maybe token IDs exceed vocab size if merges mismatch.

sophia: ran roundtrip on 1000 sample sentences. one case of OOV due to a leading BOM in vocab.bin. stripped BOM, remapped, ok. added note to release.json: "tokenizer_fix": "stripped_bom_on_vocab". also ran eval-smoke with 128-context on a couple of prompt templates — forward pass ok, no NANs. latency looks normal.

devin: good. after smoke I suggest we run a small quantization probe: 8-bit (LLM.int8()) on one shard and run perplexity vs fp32 baseline on the provided eval set. if delta < 1.5% we can suggest quantized release. who wants it?

maya: I can run quant probe tomorrow AM, will push results to the thread.

oleg: registry metadata: propose model key "vectra-27b" with version "v0". storage canonical path should be s3://redwood-model-registry/vectra-27b/v0/ and we should copy artifacts from tmp to that prefix after final checks. also need to stamp provenance fields: source_uri, receipt_ts, signer_key, manifest_hash, kms_wrapped_key_uri, license_file, model_card_path.

sophia: also add a field "smoke_eval_hash" linking to the eval snapshot in experiments bucket. and set intake_status="quarantined" until legal signs off on license.

maya: legal pinged and said preliminary ok but need to confirm the dataset license in release.json. will escalate if not clear.

artifact-validator-bot: PGP verify PASSED (key: 0xA1B2C3D4)

maya: checksum & sig done. starting quant probe now. will attach results here.

oleg: once quant probe done, let's do a short/explicit rollback plan for cases where quantized model regresses in customer LM tests: include an automatic fallback route in runtime config that can route to fp32 variant for specific endpoints. add rollout tags in registry: rollout/canary=10%

sophia: +1. I'll draft registry entry template and post a PR to model-registry service. includes fields: model_id, version, provenance: {source_uri, manifest_sha256, signer_fingerprint, receipt_ts}, runtime_profiles: [fp32, int8], recommended_default=fp32 until QA clears.

devin: ping me when quant numbers are in. I'll prepare a small perf/ops runbook for the Dedicated infra team for when we schedule the first warm-up deploy.

maya: quant probe results: int8 mean perplexity delta +0.9% vs fp32, 2.1x memory reduction on a single shard. attaching `quant-probe-1769805555.log`.

oleg: that looks acceptable. sophia, update registry entry and set recommended_default to int8 with a note "recommended for cost-sensitive workloads; rollover to fp32 if eval regressions >1.5%".

sophia: updated PR #412 in model-registry with the metadata and provenance fields. set intake_status -> ready_for_qa.

maya: copying artifacts to canonical registry path now, will set S3 object tags: provenance=redwood_ingest, receipt_ts=1769805432, signer=0xA1B2C3D4.

artifact-validator-bot: COPY COMPLETE -> s3://redwood-model-registry/vectra-27b/v0/ ; registry entry created (draft).

devin: thanks everyone. next steps: QA run, legal final signoff on license, then canary deploy. I'll coordinate with eng-oncall for a window. :rocket:

oleg: file note: bump audit ledger with KMS envelope reference: kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234 wrapped_key_sha256: e3b0c442...

maya: noted. closing intake thread unless issues pop up. thx! :tada:
